seo.title: BlockForge | Next.js CMS
seo.description: Build instant websites from structured CMS content with Next.js, schema, SEO, and deterministic JSON publishing.
seo.keywords: next.js cms, static cms, json cms, block editor

content.title: Instant test and websites from structured content
content.subtitle: BlockForge edits pages, collections, categories, SEO, and schema, then publishes deterministic JSON for Next.js to render as server-generated HTML.

content.text: CMS. Public visitors get prerendered Next.js pages with canonical URLs, OpenGraph tags, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, and no CMS JavaScript.

items.title: Configurable collections
items.description: Articles, docs, products, case studies, people, and generic entries are presets, not hardcoded limits.

items.title: Optional category pages
items.description: Categories can organize content privately or generate public collection pages when enabled.

items.title: SEO-first publishing
items.description: Validation catches missing metadata, duplicate paths, broken references, and missing image alt text before publish.
